backupInput: root-only VERIFIED encrypted current-production Wiki receipt and artifacts; dump and key hashes validated before restore
checks: TS-delegated browser session, CSRF, agent bearer, idempotency replay/conflict and revision CAS with direct Python readback
Direct Python moderation, CLI and MCP baseline

Python and TS health stayed live while readiness failed; Redis restarted and both readiness checks recovered within the bounded poll

failureControlChecks: Nonexistent root-only backup receipt was rejected before DB creation; no lock, receipt, release directory or staged helper remained

scope: Selected positive stateful requests and Redis stop/refusal/recovery were verified privately. This does not measure blackholed Redis timeout bounds, prove production ACLs or all-route response parity, or authorize a TS public rollout.
